widgets.title: Credits
widgets.description: Credits held by users, and anyone who owes credits after a refund.

permissions.name: credits:view
permissions.description: See every user's balance and ledger

permissions.name: credits:adjust
permissions.description: Take credits away, reverse a spend, claw back a grant and write off what a user owes

permissions.name: credits:transfer
permissions.description: Send your own credits to another user. Nobody holds this until the site gives it to a group

settings.name: credits_per_unit
settings.description: How many credits are worth one whole unit of the store's currency, used when a product accepts credits as payment. 100 means 1 credit is worth 1 cent

settings.name: low_balance_threshold
settings.description: Fire the credits:low hook when a user's balance drops below this many credits — once each time it crosses. 0 turns it off

settings.name: non_transferable_kinds
settings.description: Comma-separated kinds of credit that cannot be sent to another user, such as purchase. Credits of these kinds can still be spent. Blank lets every kind be transferred

groups.name: kempo-credits:support
groups.description: Looks up any user's balance and history and gives credits as goodwill, without being able to take credits away

groups.name: kempo-credits:administrator
groups.description: Everything: balances, grants and adjustments, and the settings
